title: Dependency-Ready Engineering Capability Foundations
purpose: Close every roadmap-wave-12 engineering capability whose approved dependencies are operational while preserving regulated-use boundaries.
scope: Professional foundation workflow, jurisdiction registry, evidence ledger, differential validation, project reference library and explicit CAD/BIM deferral.

requirements.title: Professional foundation workflow
requirements.statement: The workflow shall execute validated calculation and code-check engines and join their releases in one evidence chain.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Jurisdiction governance
requirements.statement: Jurisdiction packs shall be licensed, attributable, effective-date-aware and explicit about legal status and review.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Evidence ledger
requirements.statement: Engineering evidence shall be unique, attributable and linked through verifiable record hashes.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Differential validation
requirements.statement: Results shall compare exact contracts with matching units, provenance and explicit tolerances.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reference library
requirements.statement: Reference cases shall be licensed, attributable, anonymized and identity-stable.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: Wave 12 foundations shall include tests, documentation, installer, checksums and release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
